title: Ensure SSH PasswordAuthentication is disabled
threat_mapping: SSH brute force and credential dumping
justification: Disabling password auth prevents automated brute force attacks across all servers.

title: Ensure SSH PermitRootLogin is disabled
threat_mapping: SSH lateral movement and direct root compromise
justification: Restricting direct root login forces administrators to use sudo for accountability.

title: Disable IPv4 Forwarding
threat_mapping: Pivoting and lateral movement between internal subnets
justification: Prevents compromised servers from acting as routers to pivot into restricted zones.

title: Ensure ICMP Redirects are not accepted
justification: Disabling ICMP redirects prevents malicious routing table updates.

title: Enable Reverse Path Filtering (RPF)
justification: Ensures incoming packets arrive on the interface expected by the routing table.

title: Ensure PAM password quality requirements are configured
threat_mapping: Weak credential guessing and dictionary attacks
justification: Enforces complex passwords to mitigate local offline dictionary attacks.

title: Ensure PAM lockout for failed attempts is configured
justification: Locks user accounts after specified consecutive failed login attempts.

title: Ensure unneeded network services are disabled
justification: Disabling unused services minimizes listening sockets and vulnerabilities.

title: Ensure legacy RPC and rsh services are removed
justification: Removes outdated and unencrypted legacy access protocols.

title: Audit world-writable files and permissions
threat_mapping: Local privilege escalation via file tampering
justification: Removes global write privileges to protect system binaries and configs.

title: Audit SUID and SGID executables
threat_mapping: Privilege escalation via SUID binary abuse
justification: Restricts executable bits on binaries that execute with root context.

title: Ensure auditd service is installed and enabled
justification: Ensures system-level event tracing and logging is active.

title: Ensure audit rules capture privileged commands
threat_mapping: Unauthorized sudo usage and privilege abuse
justification: Captures audit events for execution of root-level commands.

title: Ensure default firewall drop policy for inbound traffic
justification: Blocks unauthorized inbound connections by default.

title: Ensure log retention policy is configured in journald
threat_mapping: Log rotation exhaust and missing incident evidence
justification: Retains system logs for required compliance and investigation periods.
